entities.summary: Syed Babar Ali OBE is a Pakistani businessman, philanthropist and former caretaker Finance Minister of Pakistan. He is the founder of Packages Limited, Milkpak Limited and Lahore University of Management Sciences. Syed Babar Ali School of Science and Engineering is named after him.
